rca of the issue: Login loop RCA: the Remember-Me useEffect on LoginPage watched `user` state — when handleSubmit's login() call transitioned user from null→authed, the effect ran with stored auth_remember='false' and immediately invoked logout(), killing the just-created session. Fix: added `justLoggedInRef` set BEFORE await login() to short-circuit the effect on this one transition, plus moved localStorage.setItem('auth_remember', …) before the await so any concurrent re-render reads the right value. Verified all 3 scenarios end with user stably on /dashboard.
